title: Crispy Chicken Skewers
description: Tasty and easy to make, these chicken skewers are perfect for a quick dinner or snack. The zesty flavor pairs well with the crispy exterior.
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes and season with zesty seasoning.
In a separate bowl, mix together crisp coating mix and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Dip each chicken cube into the coating mix, shaking off excess.
Thread the coated chicken onto the mexican skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through and crispy.
